name: NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit
description: Connects, profiles, evaluates, and optimizes agent workflows across frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and CrewAI, with MCP and A2A support and a `nat` CLI for Python developers.

skills.name: Run and Serve Workflows
skills.description: Runs YAML-defined agent workflows with `nat run` or serves them over a FastAPI server with streaming endpoints via `nat serve`.

skills.name: Workflow Evaluation
skills.description: Scores the accuracy of agent workflows against datasets with `nat eval` and records performance characteristics per run.

skills.name: Parameter and Prompt Optimizer
skills.description: Searches hyperparameters with Optuna and evolves prompts with a genetic algorithm via `nat optimize` to hit chosen metrics.

skills.name: MCP Client and Server
skills.description: Consumes remote MCP tools inside workflows and publishes workflow functions as MCP tools with the `nat mcp serve` command.
